name: formify-send-contract
title_zh: 合同发出去等签字，模板、PDF、刚聊完的草稿都行
tagline_zh: 合同写完了，卡在「怎么发出去给人签」这一步。说一句「把这份发去签」，它从已存模板、上传的 PDF。
tagline_en: You've finished the contract but stall on sending it out. Say "send this for signature" and it fires off a.
desc_en: Send a contract or document for e-signature through Formify. Use when sending something to be signed, from a saved template, an uploaded PDF, or a document drafted in this conversation. Triggers on "send for signature", "send this contract", "e-sign", "signing request", "skicka för signering", "skicka kontrakt", "enviar para firmar". Not for checking who has signed afterwards: see formify-track-si
why_zh: 取件来源是它和别的签署工具最不一样的地方：模板、PDF、对话草稿三条路都能进，不用先导出再上传。
why_en: Three intake paths — saved template, uploaded PDF, or in-chat draft — so you never export-then-reupload just to start a signing.
limit_zh: 只管「发出去」这一步：谁签了、签到哪了，它一概不答，那得换 formify-track-si。
limit_en: Only covers sending. Who signed and how far along? Not here — use formify-track-si. Needs a Formify account plus a template or uploadable file.
title_en: Send a contract out for signature from a template, PDF, or.
